image_description: A studio product shot displaying a set of five black non-stick frying pans of varying sizes arranged on a white background. The pans feature sloped sides, black interiors, and handles with silver metallic accents near the base and black grips. One pan in the foreground has grill ridges. A small detached knob or lid handle is visible in the upper right.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The handle of the large pan on the right appears to merge into the pan body without a clear mechanical joint or rivet structure. The transition is smooth and ambiguous, lacking the distinct hardware usually seen in this type of cookware.
The elliptical perspective of the rim seems slightly inconsistent with the internal grill lines, which appear somewhat flattened and less distorted than the rim would suggest for that viewing angle.
The non-stick surfaces are unnaturally uniform and lack any micro-texture, dust, or minor imperfections expected in a high-resolution product shot, giving them a slightly 'plastic' or rendered look.
